originalTitle: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
simplifiedContent: The stock market had a mixed day on Wednesday, with prices going up and down. This happened because some investors decided to sell their stocks and take their profits after prices reached a high point, which prevented the market from going up even more. The value of the rupee (India's currency) went down and oil prices went up, making investors a bit more cautious. As a result, analysts think the market will stay within a certain range for now. The "fear gauge" (a measure of how nervous investors are) actually went down, which is a bit surprising given the uncertainty.

originalTitle: Stocks in news: Wipro, Jio Financial, HDB Financial, HDFC AMC, SBI
simplifiedContent: Here's what you need to know about what happened in the stock market: the Indian stock market had a mixed day, meaning it didn't go up or down much. Several big companies, including Wipro and Jio Financial, announced how they did financially in the first quarter of the year. Some other companies like Angel One, HDB Financial, and HDFC AMC also reported that they made more money than they did last year. The State Bank of India (SBI) also made some changes by hiring a new person to handle their finances. This news is important because it can affect the prices of these companies' stocks.

originalTitle: Global Market Today: Asian equities drop led by Kospi, oil extends gain
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market today: stocks in Asia, like those in South Korea, are going down because investors are selling shares of companies that make computer chips. At the same time, the price of oil is going up because of new problems in the Middle East. This news is important because it can affect the overall direction of the market. The good news is that investors are a little less worried that the US central bank will raise interest rates, which can be a good thing for the stock market. Investors are also watching to see if companies that work with artificial intelligence can keep doing well despite these changes.

originalTitle: Crude oil prices rise for 4th session amid escalating US-Iran war; Brent likely to hit $110/bbl, says Goldman Sachs
simplifiedContent: Crude oil prices have gone up for the fourth day in a row because of increasing tensions between the US and Iran. This means that the cost of oil has increased, with Brent crude futures now at $85.28 per barrel, which is a 0.4% rise. Over the past three days, oil prices had already surged by 12%. Goldman Sachs thinks that the price of Brent crude could reach $110 per barrel. This matters because higher oil prices can affect the overall economy and the stocks of companies that rely on oil.

originalTitle: Breakout stocks to buy or sell: Sumeet Bagadia recommends five shares to buy today - 16 July 2026
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day on Wednesday and ended with higher numbers. originalTitle: Laser Power & Infra IPO listing date today. GMP, experts signal strong share debut in Indian stock market
simplifiedContent: Laser Power & Infra, a company, is listing its shares on the Indian stock market for the first time today, July 16, 2026. This is a big day for the company as its shares will start trading publicly. Experts think the company's shares will do well on their first day, meaning they will likely be worth more than their initial price. This is indicated by the "grey market premium" (GMP), which is a measure of how much people are willing to pay for the shares before they are officially listed. Overall, it seems like Laser Power & Infra is expected to have a strong start in the stock market.
